mintAuthority.summary: cdxUSD has one verified native issuance deployment on Base and uses a GHO-style facilitator bucket model. The active 3/9 Safe facilitator mints within a finite bucket, while the immutable token owner is a TimelockController with a 24-hour delay; the facilitator Safe proposes native bucket changes and the 1/8 guardian Safe executes scheduled operations. The inherited LayerZero OFT extension and its bridge administration are scoped only under risk-review.bridgeRouteRisk and do not contribute separate native mint authority.

controls.label: cdxUSD active facilitator Safe
controls.capDescription: At Base block 50064182, getFacilitator returned bucket capacity 6250000000000000000000000 (6,250,000 cdxUSD) and bucket level 6150000000000000000000000 (6,150,000 cdxUSD), leaving 100,000 cdxUSD of headroom.
controls.evidence: At Base block 50064182, getFacilitatorsList returned this address; getFacilitator returned label Multisig, capacity 6,250,000 cdxUSD, and level 6,150,000 cdxUSD. The Base Safe API returned threshold 3, 9 owners, no modules, and zero guard.

controls.label: cdxUSD owner TimelockController (24h delay)
controls.evidence: At Base block 50064039, Blockscout confirms the owner contract is an OZ TimelockController (solc 0.8.23), getMinDelay() returned 86400 (24h), PROPOSER_ROLE is held by the 3/9 facilitator Safe, and EXECUTOR_ROLE is held by the 1/8 guardian Safe. The Timelock and facilitator Safe hold the default admin role (bytes32(0)); no active admin can bypass the 24-hour delay for target calls.

controls.label: cdxUSD guardian Safe (delayed Timelock executor for native issuance)
controls.evidence: At Base block 50064182, the guardian Safe was the Timelock EXECUTOR_ROLE holder; the Base Safe API returned threshold 1, 8 owners, no modules, and zero guard. Its Mint Authority relevance is limited to executing scheduled native Facilitator administration; direct bridge pause authority is scoped under risk-review.bridgeRouteRisk.

review.evidence: At Base block 50064182, the facilitator bucket was finite at 6,250,000 cdxUSD capacity and 6,150,000 cdxUSD level; the owner contract is an OZ TimelockController with a 24-hour delay, the 3/9 Safe is PROPOSER, the 1/8 guardian is EXECUTOR, and the default-admin role does not bypass the Timelock delay for target calls. The inherited OFT and bridge administration are intentionally excluded from Mint Authority and reviewed under risk-review.bridgeRouteRisk. The finite Facilitator bucket is raiseable only through the enforced Timelock path, but no reviewed evidence reconciles Facilitator collateral to the whole supply and no independent supervisor or attestor is identified.
